passages.note: House final-passage vote on 2SB 100; 6 Nays of a 75-member body is under 10%, so it cannot carry a chair alone.

passages.provision_quote: prohibit a parent of a child from accessing the child's education record
passages.note: Operative section guarantees parent access to the education record and requires consent for gender-identity changes to the record; it neither requires notification nor parental permission before staff use a name or pronouns, so it shows only the parent-information side.

rows.reasoning: Abbott voted Yea on SB 100 (2023), whose operative text bars a school from preventing a parent from accessing the child's education record and from changing the record's gender identity without written parental consent. That shows the parent-information side but matches neither "Require schools to notify parents" nor "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns" clause for clause, and the 59-6 vote is near-unanimous.
